title: A Prayer for the Captive People
english: Your people of faith; even though we are unworthy of your philanthropy, yet we are sheep of your Church, gathered together as one. This entreaty we offer to you on behalf of a multitude of captive people: in your three-day resurrection, priests and peoples, youths and virgins, elders with the younger, and infants with their mothers approach you—every soul of those who believe in you. Redeem them all from every looming threat, and make them worthy of your kingdom through the grace and philanthropy of your only-begotten Son and Lord God and Savior, Jesus Christ, with his all-holy and life-giving Spirit; now and always and unto the ages of ages. Amen.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
baehrens: PG Homilia in Christi resurrectionem u02-open
